aiFlow.noMppsAssigned: You are not assigned to any MPP yet. Contact your administrator.
aiFlow.noMembers: No members found at this MPP.

aiFlow.noNonMembersMatch: No farmer here matches that search.

aiFlow.searchMemberHint: Search by code, name or mobile

aiFlow.numberAlreadyOnFile: This number is already on file
aiFlow.numberIsAMembers: {{name}} is a member here, and she pays nothing today. If that is the same farmer, go back and record her as a member.
aiFlow.numberIsANonMembers: {{name}} is already registered here. If that is the same farmer, pick her instead of registering her twice.

aiFlow.nothingToCollect: Nothing to collect — ₹ {{amount}} comes out of her milk payment.
aiFlow.nothingToCollectPlain: Nothing to collect — it comes out of her milk payment.
aiFlow.codeSentTo: Code sent to {{mobile}}. Ask her to read it out.

aiFlow.newNonMemberSubtitle: Her mobile is how the receipt reaches her.

aiFlow.frameCardFront: Front of the card, inside the frame

aiFlow.galleryDenied: This phone has not allowed access to photos
aiFlow.chosenWithPin: The record will say this photo was chosen, and the pin is the one written into it.
aiFlow.chosenNoPin: The record will say this photo was chosen. The pin is where this phone is now, not where the photo was taken.

aiFlow.noPinBody: Turn location on before the next one, or the event cannot be tied to a village.
aiFlow.photoTakenSubtitle: It has to show the animal you just served.
aiFlow.cameraNeededTitle: The camera is how the event is proved

aiFlow.cameraNeededSubtitle: Allow the camera to carry on.
aiFlow.savedOfflineBody: {{count}} waiting to send. They go automatically when you have signal.
aiFlow.queueExpired: {{count}} could not be sent in time
aiFlow.queueExpiredBody: Show this phone to the IT department — do not delete the app.
aiFlow.herdRequiredHint: Both are needed. Write 0 for an animal she does not keep.
aiFlow.dailyMilkHint: Litres across the whole herd, as she reports it. Write 0 if she is not milking.
aiFlow.animalPhotoBody: So you recognise her next visit
aiFlow.codeGoesToHer: The code goes to her own phone
aiFlow.codeGoesToHerBody: Read off her record, never typed here. She reads it back to you.
aiFlow.whatDidYouUseSubtitle: Doses and consumables both come off your stock.
aiFlow.twoDosesTwoSheaths: Two doses in one visit usually means two sheaths. Correct the count if you used fewer.
aiFlow.noConsumablesBody: Sheaths and gloves appear here once the store issues them.
aiFlow.pinFirstTitle: The pin is being found first
aiFlow.pinFirstBody: The camera opens once this phone knows where it is. A proof photo with no location cannot be tied to a village.
aiFlow.pinNeededSubtitle: The location is needed before the camera opens.
aiFlow.pinDeniedTitle: This phone has not allowed location
aiFlow.pinDeniedBody: Allow it to carry on. Every insemination is recorded against the place it happened, so the photo cannot be taken without it.
aiFlow.pinOffTitle: Location is switched off on this phone
aiFlow.pinOffBody: Switch location on in the phone's settings, then try again. Nothing else on this screen will work until it is on.
aiFlow.pinFailedBody: Step outside or away from the shed roof and try again. A fix under cover can take much longer, or never come.
aiFlow.officeAsk: SMS not reaching her? Ask the office to call her
aiFlow.officeAskedBody: On {{mobile}}, the number on her record. Type in the code she tells you — it works for 10 minutes.
aiFlow.officeAskFailed: Could not reach the office. Check the signal and try again.

pd.sentBody: The record is with the office.

pd.backToList: Not today — back to the list
pd.allDone: That was the last one this week
pd.recordedRecheck: A recheck was booked for 21 days later.

pd.consentYesHint: Examine her and record what you find
pd.consentNoHint: She will not be examined today

pd.recordedDeclined: The owner declined. Nothing was examined and nothing was charged.
pd.doneDeclinedBody: The refusal is on the record, so nobody will ask you why this check is still open. There is nothing left to do here.
pd.chargeMember: ₹ {{amount}} comes out of her milk payment
pd.chargeMemberHint: Nothing to collect in the yard.
pd.chargeUnpricedHint: Do not quote a figure. Tell the office the rate is missing.
pd.doneChargeMemberBody: Nothing to collect here. The dairy deducts it at the next payout.
pd.doneChargeNonMemberBody: Cash from the owner, before you leave the yard.
pd.doneChargeNoneBody: She was not examined, so there is nothing to collect and nothing to deduct.
pd.doneChargeUnpricedBody: The office has not set a price for this visit. Do not quote a figure; the record shows the visit was made.

route2.unplaced_other: {{count}} checks have no recorded location and are listed last.

route2.estimate: Distances are straight lines between where each animal was last served, scaled for winding roads — not road directions. The real ride is longer, and further where a river or canal has to be gone around. Worked out once when you tap Plan and held, so reordering offline uses the same figures.
